The test in Step 105 shows the decoder successfully read the first integer with 0 prefix iterations (not 25), correctly decoding to j=180. This contradicts the "arithmetic state evolution causing 25 prefix iterations" theory in the debugging findings—that was likely from an earlier buggy version.

The fixed compress.c appears to be encoding the first integer correctly. The failure mode (0 bytes output despite j=180) suggests the issue is in the main decompression loop, not a fundamental protocol mismatch. Check what happens in subsequent get_integer calls or the loop body rather than revisiting the protocol theory.
